candidates.topic: Full Moon in Pisces — Four Planets Retrograde Amplified
candidates.teaser: Tonight's Full Moon in Pisces is being pulled in four directions at once — and most people won't even notice what's hitting them.
candidates.video_title: This Full Moon in Pisces Hits Differently Tonight
candidates.video_description: The Full Moon at 21° Pisces on September 25 lands while Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto are all retrograde. Astrologers say this amplifies emotional overwhelm and buried feelings rising to the surface. Find out which signs feel it most.
candidates.script: Four planets are retrograde tonight, and the Full Moon just landed in Pisces — the most emotionally porous sign in the zodiac. In astrology, a Pisces Full Moon already dissolves your defenses. But with Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto all moving backward, the pressure isn't coming from outside — it's coming from deep within you. Things you buried weeks ago are surfacing right now. Especially if you're a Pisces, Virgo, Scorpio, or Cancer. What's coming up for you?

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries Opposite Mars in Cancer
candidates.teaser: Saturn in Aries and Mars in Cancer are in a standoff right now — and one of them is about to make you crack.
candidates.video_title: Saturn vs. Mars: The Tension No One's Talking About
candidates.video_description: Saturn retrograde at 12° Aries sits in opposition to Mars at 28° Cancer, creating a push-pull between discipline and emotional reaction. Astrologers interpret this as a battle between what you're told to do and what you actually feel. Cardinal signs are caught in the middle.
candidates.script: Saturn retrograde is sitting in Aries right now — demanding discipline, boundaries, rules. Mars is sitting in Cancer — running on raw emotion and instinct. These two are in direct opposition, and in astrology that means internal war. The part of you that wants to hold it together is fighting the part of you that just wants to feel everything. If you're Aries, Cancer, Libra, or Capricorn, this tension is personal. Which side is winning for you right now?

candidates.topic: Venus in Scorpio Trine Mars in Cancer — Water Trine
candidates.teaser: Venus in Scorpio and Mars in Cancer are forming one of the most emotionally magnetic combinations in astrology right now.
candidates.video_title: Venus and Mars in Water Signs — Rare Emotional Pull
candidates.video_description: Venus at 7° Scorpio and Mars at 28° Cancer are both in water signs, forming a trine that astrologers associate with deep emotional attraction and intuitive connection. This aspect intensifies desire and vulnerability simultaneously. Water signs feel this most acutely.
candidates.script: Venus is in Scorpio and Mars is in Cancer — both water signs, both emotionally driven, and right now they're in a trine. In astrology, this is the combination that makes feelings impossible to ignore. It's not loud or dramatic. It's the kind of pull you feel before you understand it. Desire becomes deeply personal. Vulnerability stops feeling like weakness. If you've been avoiding something — or someone — this energy won't let you much longer. Water signs especially know exactly what I mean.

candidates.topic: Mercury Retrograde Shadow Period — Starts in 29 Days
candidates.teaser: Mercury isn't retrograde yet — but the shadow period is closer than you think, and it changes how you should be communicating right now.
candidates.video_title: Mercury Retrograde Shadow Starts Soon — Here's What to Do
candidates.video_description: Mercury goes retrograde on October 24, 2026, meaning the pre-shadow phase begins soon. Astrologers suggest this is the window to finish conversations, sign documents, and clarify plans before communication starts to blur. Mercury is currently in Libra at 23°.
candidates.script: Mercury is not retrograde right now — but mark October 24th in your calendar, because that's when it flips. And the shadow period starts before that. Mercury is currently moving through Libra at 23 degrees, which in astrology is the zone of negotiation and diplomacy. This is your window — finish the difficult conversations, review anything you're about to sign, and say the things you've been sitting on. Because once the retrograde hits, the wires start crossing. You've been warned.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 12th House — Pisces, Neptune, and What You Hide
candidates.teaser: The 12th house is the one part of your birth chart most astrologers say people are genuinely afraid to look at.
candidates.video_title: The 12th House: The Part of Your Chart You're Hiding From
candidates.video_description: The 12th house in astrology is associated with the unconscious, hidden enemies, isolation, and self-undoing. Ruled by Neptune and connected to Pisces, it represents what we conceal — even from ourselves. With a Full Moon in Pisces tonight, this energy is especially activated.
candidates.script: The 12th house in your birth chart has exactly one job — to hide things from you. It's the house of the unconscious, of secrets, of patterns you repeat without knowing why. Traditional astrologers called it the house of self-undoing. Neptune rules it. Pisces rules it. And with tonight's Full Moon sitting in Pisces, whatever your 12th house has been holding for you is a lot harder to ignore right now. Pull up your chart. Look at what's in there. Most people are genuinely surprised.
